title.en: sunday book market at sant antoni.
title.tr: pazar sabahı sant antoni kitap pazarı.

line.en: the sunday book and collectibles market on comte d'urgell, open 08:30 to 14:00. a slow morning among old books.
line.de: der sonntägliche bücher- und sammlermarkt an der comte d'urgell, geöffnet 08:30 bis 14:00. ein ruhiger vormittag zwischen alten büchern.
line.tr: comte d'urgell'deki pazar kitap ve koleksiyon pazarı, 08:30 ile 14:00 arası açık. eski kitaplar arasında sakin bir sabah.

sparks.why: Mercat dominical de Sant Antoni, Ajuntament de Barcelona market page: books and collectibles, Sundays 08:30 to 14:00. No November notice found.
